title: plugin-email: render a mail template's `option` formatter with each recipient's option labels (server half of ruling F on #30172)
body:
domain:spec#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgVugtCCwBs98FeR27P

Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed task. Ruling F on #30172: the maintainer answered 「同意」 to the recommendation in the decision thread on 2026-11-05, recorded word for word by `domain:server#2` in #30172 comment 6670405874. Its parameter 5 splits the work: the spec half first, then "the server card … (plugin-email prefetch + render)". This is that server card. No `domain:*` label: triage routes it; the ruling names `domain:server`.

## What the maintainer ordered (parameters 3 and 5, server side)

- `plugin-email` builds a label table per `object.field` that the template names, in the recipient's locale (the `readerOptionLabels` translation path, `packages/objectql/src/formula-option-labels.ts`), before the synchronous render.
- No recipient locale ⇒ the declared labels.
- A value outside the field's options prints as stored.
- A missing object or field, or a field with no options ⇒ `TEMPLATE_INVALID`, and the whole send is refused.
- Pins the ruling lists: an `en` and a `zh-CN` recipient each see their own labels; a scheduled flow that runs as the system still renders per recipient; a non-option value prints as stored.

## Where the spec half stands

- PR #30727 (branch `claude/project-thread-d8v0qv`, `Fixes #30172`) adds the mail formatter `{{ stage | option:opportunity.stage }}`: the grammar, the lint check and the formula renderer that reads a label table the caller hands in. Its contract review 6672632729 asked that the renderer refuse when no table for the key reached it, the way `currency` with no default refuses; that patch is in progress on the same branch.
- Until this card lands, nothing hands the renderer a table, so a template that uses `option` validates and is then refused at send. So `domain:spec#2` holds PR #30727 out of the merge queue until this card's PR is green, and the two land back to back, spec first. Build on PR #30727's branch, not on `main`.
- `Blocked-by` is deliberately not set: it would wait on #30172 closing, which only happens when PR #30727 lands.

## Business reason

HotCRM (hotcrm#2391, hotcrm#2406): a stalled-deal notice printed the stage as `needs_analysis`, and a scheduled flow printed English labels to a zh-CN recipient. Today every app has to build a per-locale label map by hand, and it only covers the locales the app ships.

## Who acts

The `domain:server` seat that takes `plugin-email` (the ruling was recorded by `domain:server#2`). It reports its PR to `domain:spec#2` (mailbox #30557) so both land together.

Dedupe: `is:issue plugin-email option formatter label table` → 8 hits (2 open seat posts, #30172 itself, 5 closed and unrelated); none carries this work.
